comparison.objective: Mount the final bicycle-tire bead section by creating slack in the rim center channel.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual distributed bead depression and rolling a compliant bead over a flange without harmful lever intrusion.
comparison.success_condition: Bead seated all around, valve aligned, tube unpunctured, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable-bead slack management and tube protection, not rigid coaxial/parallel interface mating and containment of independently mobile rolling elements.
